name: Nuoc mam nhi Cua Dai
summary: Nước mắm nhỉ Cửa Đại is a second fish sauce. The Fatherland Front’s OCOP account spells it nhĩ and lists it as a 2022 target. The fair of 22–24 Sep 2023 spells it nhỉ and includes it among recognized OCOP products. No star count is printed on the fair page.
origin: Duy Xuyên. The 2022 target and the Sep 2023 fair do not print the same status.
howToEat: Neither note describes a use. The method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Neither note prints a village for this sauce. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam nhi Cua Dai — two spellings, two statuses
seoDescription: One Fatherland Front note spells nước mắm nhĩ Cửa Đại and calls it a 2022 target. The Sep 2023 fair spells nhỉ and lists it as recognized. No price was printed.
